subject: Candidate migration 386 rollout and current-use gate deployment

restore_rehearsal.target: kokonut_restore from template0 in internal-only project kokonut-m386-checkpoint-restore-20261013
restore_rehearsal.age_decryption_and_pg_restore: passed without writing a plaintext archive

checkpoint.scope: PostgreSQL kokonut_intelligence only; excludes roles/grants, other databases, Docker volumes, external media, and provider state.

migration.command: python -m services.migration.cli migrate --schemas-only --compose-project kokonut-kernel-candidate --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-candidate.yml --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-metabase.yml
migration.directus_permissions_table: absent; optional Directus provider is disabled in the Kernel candidate

rollback.policy: Retain the additive migration and its database guards for an app-only rollback. Because the candidate had no farm activity, workflow event, or mobile collection rows at rollout, the encrypted checkpoint remains a viable pre-migration restore point; after accepting governed data, prefer a reviewed forward migration.

limitations: The candidate contained no farm-activity, workflow-event, offline-collection, or mobile-device rows; candidate rollout confirms deployment and protected-route behavior, not populated domain workflow behavior.
Directus is optional and absent from the Kernel candidate; Directus policy SQL and idempotent seed repair passed separate disposable PostgreSQL acceptance.
OIDC provider login/session and operator grants remain unconfigured; MAN-CAP-001 and MAN-CAP-053 remain not run.
